abstract: Let $\mathcal{E}$ be a vector bundle of rank $n\geq 2$ over a smooth projective curve $C$ over $\mathbb{C}$. We prove that $\omega_{\mathbb{P}_C(\mathcal{E})}\otimes\mathcal{L}_1\otimes\dots\otimes\mathcal{L}_k$ is very ample for arbitrary ample line bundles $\mathcal{L}_i$ on ${\mathbb{P}_C(\mathcal{E})}$ when $k\geq n+2$.
hook: Canonical bundle plus n+2 ample bundles is very ample on P^(n-1)-bundles over curves
summary: A conjecture of Fujita predicts when a canonical bundle twisted by ample line bundles is very ample. The author proves it for projective bundles of rank n over a smooth complex curve once at least n+2 ample bundles are added. The result covers only this family of spaces, not general varieties.
title: Fujita's Very Ampleness Conjecture for $\mathbb{P}^{n-1}$-Bundles over Curves
